scenes.problem: Calculate (0.2)^2. Show the repeated factors and decimal scale.
rows: Identify the base 0.2 and the exponent 2; a square repeats the same factor 2 times.
Expand the power: (0.2)^2 = 0.2 × 0.2.
Each factor has 1 decimal place(s), so the product has 2 × 1 = 2 decimal places before removing trailing zeros.
Compute the integer product: 2 × 2 = 4.
Place the decimal point 2 positions from the right: 0.04.
scenes.memo: 0.2 × 0.2 = 0.04; repeated multiplication checks the original power.
scenes.misconception: Do not multiply the base by the exponent; show repeated equal factors.
